question: Do documented input observations and the frozen code/spread/move table identify physical quote paths, or only a supervised coordinate after an extra observation-map/reference assumption?
reads: Existing HOST_DATA_DESCRIPTION plus frozen round2 decoder_tables and its PREREG, own frozen decoder audit PREREG; contracts/resource wrapper. No raw parquet, hybrid scoring, model/live source, target fitting or recalibration.

assumptions.documented: 112 float32 fields encode two L11 book representations, trade price/volume and8 unspecified extras. Price index is component identity, not depth. No inverse normalization, fixed physical origin, tick conversion, trade carry-forward grammar, absolute reference, relative-instrument calibration or semantics for extras is supplied.
assumptions.conditional_decoder: Frozen code->class/spread and code-pair->move table is a supervised coordinate. Prefix anchor (bid=0,ask=spread) fixes an additive coordinate constant only. We do not refit or assume it is physical.
assumptions.toy_observation_map: A causal time-stationary encoder maps CURRENT centered book shape into two exact frozen22-float price codes. Remaining90 fields are causal volume, current trade-relative-price and extras functions of the same phase; four latest trades occur at the current observation in each instrument. This is one encoding allowed by the documentation, not a claim about the supplied encoder.
assumptions.gauge: P_t=U_t+g_t and common future reference F_t=K+g_t gives identical labels yL=q*(K-Uask_t),yS=q*(Ubid_t-K). Common translation leaves spread/relative book shape invariant; both instruments and current trades share the translation. A known time-independent invertible absolute-price transform would remove this time-varying freedom but is an EXTRA assumption.

frozen_code_selector: Lexicographically first reversible frozen code pair with both spread/class maps in the same class, opposite directed moves, move/spread consistency, nonconstant midpoint and overlapping entry bid/ask intervals. No target reads. If none, report actual frozen-code fixture unavailable rather than tune selection.
procedure: Make32 observed phases alternating the selected frozen pair, with decoded coordinates U from the frozen moves/spreads. World0 physical quotes=P0=U+100, common reference constantK+100. World1 quotes=P1=U+g, g0=100, g[t+1]=g[t]+K-midpoint(U[t+1]); its F_t=K+g_t is the ACTUAL next-step physical midpoint. Book/deep-level shapes, volumes and current trades encode the same112 inputs in both worlds. No labels enter the input encoder; labels are generated only for equality diagnostics. Use an extra final quote to define the last future midpoint.
candidate_anchors: spread consistency and within-side depth ordering in the toy books
second-instrument relative book, current trade-relative prices/volumes and8 unspecified extras
initial physical-price anchor at t0 only (negative control for time-varying gauge)
positive_controls: Known absolute best bid at EVERY row breaks the two-world equivalence; its known unit/origin reconstructs both quotes using spread.
Known absolute common reference at EVERY row breaks equivalence and recovers physical quotes from U.

Extra invariant-slot assumption: one immutable physical trade held across adjacent rows and its trade price is centered using the SAME current midpoint/unit as book fields. A translation change then changes the observable stored-trade-minus-current-midpoint; stable slot identity matters.
negative_controls: Initial absolute anchor alone cannot resolve later gauge shifts.
Refreshing all trade slots at each row retains gauge invariance even though trade fields exist.
A label-relative decoder reset/first-known spread is not a physical anchor.
falsifier: The proposed unidentifiability witness fails if the selected fixture is absent, physical paths/moves are identical, any of112 base observations or regenerated code keys/table outputs differ, or labels differ. Report measured failures/unknowns without changing the law, encoder, selector or threshold. Controls must separately detect the difference under their explicitly added anchor assumptions; do not treat synthetic anchor fields as present in supplied data.
decision_rule: If two physical paths differ with identical documented observations and frozen decoder outputs, physical quote teachers are not identified by documentation/table alone. They may be used only as explicitly named label-coordinate proxy supervision or if extra observation/anchor assumptions are established independently. No exact physical-extrema/stop/execution teacher should be approved from this toy or conditional table agreement alone.
